Class Player

java.lang.Object
main.character.GameCharacter
main.character.Player
public class Player extends GameCharacter
Represents a player character in the game. Extends GameCharacter with player-specific defaults and functionality.

  • Constructor Details

    • Player

      public Player(String name, double maxHealth, int strength, int dexterity, int intelligence)
      Creates a new player with specified stats and max health.
      Parameters:
      name - The player's name
      maxHealth - The maximum health of the player
      strength - The player's strength stat (affects physical damage)
      dexterity - The player's dexterity stat (affects turn order)
      intelligence - The player's intelligence stat (affects magic damage)

    • Player

      public Player(String name)
      Creates a new player with default stats and max health. Uses DEFAULT_PLAYER_MAX_HEALTH for the max health value and minimum values for strength, dexterity, and intelligence.
      Parameters:
      name - The player's name

    • Player

      public Player(String name, int strength, int dexterity, int intelligence)

      name - The player's name
      strength - The player's strength stat (affects physical damage)
      dexterity - The player's dexterity stat (affects turn order)
      intelligence - The player's intelligence stat (affects magic damage)
